name: Nango — Google Drive
description: Google Drive access through Nango OAuth. Registers one provider tool whose credentialRef is the stable nango://google-drive ref (Nango holds the OAuth credential — no vault secret). The dispatcher resolves the user's most-recent google-drive connection (Connection-Id + Provider-Config-Key) and proxies requests to the Google Drive API. PRECONDITION: a Nango integration with providerConfigKey 'google-drive' must already exist and the acting user must have connected their Google account via Settings -> Connectors. Drive code skills (create folder, share link, list files) are NOT seeded here — those connector operations are not yet built; this template establishes the connection + auth so those skills can land later.

tools.name: gdrive
tools.description: Google Drive access through Nango. credentialRef nango://google-drive resolves the user's Google connection (Connection-Id + Provider-Config-Key) and proxies the request to the Google Drive API.
